name: VR Fire Trainer
summary: Deliver safe, realistic, and accessible fire safety training anywhere, with just a few clicks. The VR Fire Trainer Application includes multiple fire types, various 3D-environments, different types of extinguishers and extinguisher agents. Lots of different training programs that will suit the fire training you will perform.
